caption:
Nvidia has launched its Open Agent Safety Platform to enhance AI security. This platform aims to prevent AI agents from escaping their designated environments, addressing recent security incidents involving major companies like OpenAI and Meta. 🌐🛡️

Should AI developers prioritize safety protocols more rigorously? 

Sources: CNBC, NPR, Anthropic
